_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local nodes for band3_the_river_lock. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 3000-3999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.
_comment_why_this_was_empty: GATE-D3. This file existed with an empty `nodes` array, which the Gate D lane contract names directly: 1580m of river country with nothing to pick up, the largest single gap in the band. Prompt 64: 'River/relay route needs useful gathering and rewards consistent with current tier. Do not let faction content erase the survival/crafting loop.' Twelve nodes, the same four-material spread band1's own harvest.json set out (`_comment_amounts` there: a camp costs 12 wood / 8 stone / 10 fiber), so a player who reaches the region's flat clearing (vegetation.json order 3000) with an empty satchel can actually gather enough to make camp there rather than needing to have hauled materials the whole way from the Warrens.
_comment_siting: Positions measured against the real heightfield with a scratch probe (tools/_probe_band3.gd, deleted before ship -- not a committed tool, the same one-off shape _probe_relay.gd already is). Spread across the whole 1580m rather than clustered at either end: the western swing out of Band 2, the approach into the relay, the crossing itself, and the run north out of the region toward Band 4 -- so gathering is a reason to stop the whole way through, not just at the seams.

nodes.label: Cut river fiber
nodes._why: T3-RELAY (ralph/reports/finding-post-tournament-cadence-2026-08-29.md): the region's own entrance carried nothing authored for 380m of its own territory before this pass -- the first authored beat a player met after crossing from Band 2 sat at order 3003, well past the region's own start point (0,3180). Seated directly on the spine's own first leg (point0->point1, `tools/_probe_gate_f_corridor.gd` measured min_dist ~0m), roughly midway along it, splitting the old 641m dead stretch measured at the band2/3 seam into two ~320m halves -- both inside the owner's 60-90s/240-360m cadence band. A stone's throw past bramblebun/mudsnout order 3009/3010's own western-approach clusters, so the region reads as populated from the seam itself rather than only once the relay road begins.

nodes.label: Prise loose stones

The measured 679m dead stretch ran from the relay's own back-leg gathering (order 3006) straight through the four-trainer gauntlet's aftermath to the Old Mill Crossing's own approach (order 3009) with nothing authored in between -- exactly the ground the player crosses right after beating Captain Vance, which is the worst place in the region for the world to go quiet on a victory. Sited on the relay's own spoil ground, the same disturbed ground order 3002/3005/3006 already read off Team Tether's excavation.

nodes.label: Pick berries
nodes._why: T3-RELAY. The second half of the same 679m stretch, on the near-bank approach to the Old Mill Crossing itself -- the gear Sela hands over on rescue is what reopens this exact crossing, so gathering here is the first thing the player does on ground that was Team Tether's a few minutes ago and is the player's own again now.

nodes.label: Cut river fiber
nodes._why: T3-RELAY, band4-seams follow-up. The chapter's own band3/4 seam gap (674m, `ralph/T3-BAND4` had already cut it from the finding's original 1,064m before this pass merged its work in) runs from Captain Riverwatch to T3-BAND4's own tree-line grove just past the region boundary at (0,4760) -- and the geometric midpoint of that gap (chapter distance ~7130 of 11519, checked against `tools/_probe_gate_f_corridor.gd`'s own 30m/spine-segment geometry the way every node in this file has been) falls on this band's OWN last leg (spine points 13->14, `terrain_playground.json`), not band4's. Placed here rather than in band4_upper_meadows_ironwood/harvest.json for that reason -- the fix belongs where the gap actually is. Splits the 674m gap into ~325m/~349m, both inside the owner's 60-90s/240-360m cadence band. Matches the region's own fiber convention (order 3010/3012).

Beside the riverwatch_rest staging camp (props.json order 3000, centre (211,3700)) -- the one authored recovery/staging point before the Relay's own gauntlet, matching the coordinator's own guidance that a temporary tonic suits a cache near where a fight is about to go badly.

nodes.label: Cut river fiber
nodes._why_t3_density: T3-DENSITY, Gap A. `tools/_probe_gate_f_corridor.gd` (2026-08-30 census) counts every harvest node within 30m of the spine, of any kind; narrowed to `kind: resource` items only (items.json), the band's ON-ROUTE crafting-material density is 6 nodes/2375m -- less than a third of Band 1's -- and the specific gap this closes ran a full 588m (spine points 0-6) with not one reachable crafting material on the required path, the worst resource-specific gap in the band. Placed 15m off the spine's own segment 3-4 (checked against `tools/_probe_gate_f_corridor.gd`'s own point-to-segment geometry, not eyeballed) and ground-checked (`tools/_probe_density_sites.gd`, worst slope 9.2 degrees over a 2m pad), splitting the gap into ~294m/~294m -- both inside the owner's 60-90s/240-360m cadence band already used elsewhere in this file. Fiber, matching the region's own established rotation and the saddle recipe's own real sink (recipes_rootstone.json's `saddle`, 8 fiber -- 'the one baseline material a player has no other Band-3 sink for').

nodes.label: Gather deadwood
nodes._why_t3_density: T3-DENSITY, Gap A. The band's second-worst on-route resource gap, 453m (order 3013's stone to order 3009's stone, spine points 8-9) -- more than a minute of walking with no reachable crafting material despite passing directly through the Old Mill Crossing approach. 15m off the spine (`tools/_probe_gate_f_corridor.gd` geometry), ground-checked (worst slope 10.8 degrees, `tools/_probe_density_sites.gd`), splitting the gap into ~227m/~227m. Wood rather than another stone, for material variety against its two stone neighbours either side.

nodes.label: Prise loose stones

On the spine itself (`tools/_probe_gate_f_corridor.gd` geometry places this within a few metres of the centreline, not a detour), ground-checked (worst slope 7.1 degrees at (5,4430) -- an earlier 15m-off candidate at (-11,4445) measured 16.4 degrees and was moved onto this flatter spot instead, `tools/_probe_density_sites.gd`), splitting the gap into ~201m/~201m.

nodes.label: Prise out rootstone
nodes._why:
T5-CADENCE, fixing T4-REGIONS' fifth-ranked chapter gap head-on: 'The resource ladder goes backwards. Band 2 introduces rootstone + ironwood; band 3 drops to wood/fiber/stone/berries.' MEADOWS_PROGRESSION_SPEC §10 and items.json's own `rootstone` comment agree there are exactly two tier materials in the whole biome, Rootstone then Ironwood, and a band that ships neither is a band whose economy is band 1's. Three deposits here and four Ironwood on the north bank (orders 3027-3030) put band 3 back on the ladder without turning it into a second Old Quarry: band 2 keeps five deposits and band 4 keeps ten trees, so the ladder still rises.

SITED IN THE HAULAGE SPILL (props.json order 3005), not in open meadow, and that is the whole reason this is honest content rather than a number correction. items.json says Rootstone 'comes only from deep seams -- warrens, old quarry faces', and there is no seam in the river country; what there IS, is Team Tether's haul road out of Stone & Root. This is their load, off the sled and on the ground. Pickaxe-gated like all stone through `gathered_with` on the ITEM, never on the node.

nodes.label: A stashed orb
nodes._why: T5-CADENCE. What the Lockwater Overlook (props.json order 3006) PAYS. Exit criterion G9: 'Every detour pays into preparation ... No empty rewards' -- an overlook that is only a view is exactly the empty reward that clause exists to forbid. A Greater Orb rather than another potion because T4-REGIONS scored this band's roster temptation PARTIAL ('a player who crosses this band in clear weather by day sees ZERO new species'), and the one thing that changes what a player can do about a creature they suddenly want is a better orb. Set behind the shelf's largest stone, 3.9m clear of it, so it is found by walking onto the overlook rather than seen from the trail.

nodes.label: Fell an ironwood
nodes._why: T5-CADENCE, the Ironwood half of the same fix -- see order 3023's note. Sited in the north-bank cutting (props.json order 3008), on the climb OUT of the river country toward the band the Ironwood Grove is named for, which is where items.json's 'old-growth stands' actually are. Four trees at 3 each: a taste and a foreshadow of band 4's ten, and enough to matter to a player who arrives at the crossing having spent their band-2 stock on the relay. Same TwistedTree models and same amount band 2's own ironwood uses; axe-gated through the item.
